item.title: Ask HN: What are the fun projects wroth trying with a Linux gaming handheld?
item.summary: I own a Miyoo Flip V2, which is a lovely device. I'm kinda bored at playing games with it, so in the past few months, I didn't use it very much. But it's a very capable pocket machine with Linux in it. I connected it through SSH and it has all basic softwares (and I think we can just add more). So, I've been trying to brainstorm fun ideas that I can do with it. But to be honest, fun, useful and offline ideas are really hard to come by. I would like to ask for your help, and see what ideas that are worth trying! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49426114 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
